# Allowlist for GitHub Actions in this repo. Lines starting with # are
# comments. Each entry is an `<owner>/<repo>` allowlisted to be used as
# `uses:` in any workflow under .github/workflows/. SHAs aren't stored
# here — workflow files SHA-pin per ACTION_PIN_POLICY.md; this file
# governs *which* upstream repos are eligible to be imported at all.
#
# Adding a new entry: open a PR. CODEOWNERS routes it to
# @webflow/infrastructure-security for review. Include in the PR
# description: (a) what the action does, (b) why a `run:` step won't
# suffice, (c) maintainer posture (first-party / well-known org /
# small team / single maintainer), (d) the SHA you intend to pin.

# --- GitHub first-party ---
# Repository checkout. Read-only at workflow root.
actions/checkout

# Go toolchain installer. Pinned via go-version-file: go.mod with
# check-latest: false.
actions/setup-go

# Artifact handoff between matrix jobs in the release pipeline.
# Same trust boundary as GITHUB_TOKEN; first-party.
actions/upload-artifact
actions/download-artifact

# Attestation publishing to GitHub's native store. Used by the release
# workflow to attach SLSA provenance and SBOM attestations to release
# artifacts; verifiable with `gh attestation verify`.
actions/attest-build-provenance
actions/attest-sbom

# CodeQL static-analysis. GitHub-published, runs entirely on the
# workflow runtime trust boundary so the wrapper-aversion rule yields.
github/codeql-action

# --- Sigstore (CNCF graduated) ---
# Cosign installer. One of the few wrapper actions we accept — its only
# job is to fetch a Sigstore-signed cosign binary from a CNCF-graduated
# project. The alternative (curl + checksum-verify) is no safer and adds
# 10 lines per workflow.
sigstore/cosign-installer

# --- OpenSSF first-party ---
# Scorecard. The canonical OSS supply-chain scoring action. Results
# publish to code-scanning; we badge the score in README.
ossf/scorecard-action

# --- SLSA framework reusable workflow ---
# slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator/.github/workflows/builder_go_slsa3.yml@<sha>
# Reusable workflow that runs the Go build on an isolated GitHub-hosted
# runner with Sigstore-verified provenance. The one third-party
# reusable workflow we trust, justified by its isolated-runner property
# (build commits committed mid-build can't tamper). Collaborated on by
# Google, Chainguard, and the Linux Foundation.
slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator
